content.introduction: The Yahoo Finance dashboard lists NU Nu Holdings Ltd., Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc., NVIDIA Corporation, Space Exploration Technologies Corp., and Intel Corporation as the most active stocks. The top gainers include United Therapeutics Corporation, Rogers Corporation, FormFactor, Inc., newcleo plc, and Zeta Global Holdings Corp. Recent news highlights include a sell-off in the Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq due to surging bond yields on inflation worries, a rise in the 10-year Treasury yield to its highest level since 2007, Brent crude oil prices hovering around $96 due to a potential Trump diesel export ban, and US stocks edging lower ahead of a Trump-Xi meeting. The trending tickers include Nike, Inc., NVIDIA Corporation, Space Exploration Technologies Corp., Intel Corporation, and American Airlines Group Inc.
